issue.title: Bug:Removing a vlan member followed by adding the port to portchannel may sometime lead to crash if configs are processed in reverse order when orchagent is busy

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

When a port, which is part of a Vlan is removed from it and gets added to portchannel, sometimes when orchagent is busy the configs may get queued in redis and during processing, it gets handled in alphabetical order and not chrological order.

This would result in error logs like below and orchagent crash for versions before 202505.

```
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.592292 sonic ERR syncd#SDK: [SAI_LAG.ERR] ./src/mlnx_sai_lag.c[726]- validate_port: Can't add port which is under bridge
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.592461 sonic ERR syncd#SDK: :- sendApiResponse: api SAI_COMMON_API_CREATE failed in syncd mode: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.592926 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- create: create status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.593116 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- addLagMember: Failed to add member Ethernet0 to LAG PortChannel1 lid:20000000005a8 pid:100000000000d
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.593529 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiFailure: Encountered failure in create operation, SAI API: SAI_API_LAG, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.593570 sonic ERR syncd#SDK: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_LAG_MEMBER_ATTR_LAG_ID: oid:0x20000000005a8
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.593570 sonic ERR syncd#SDK: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_LAG_MEMBER_ATTR_PORT_ID: oid:0x100000000000d
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.593598 sonic ERR syncd#SDK: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_LAG_MEMBER_ATTR_EGRESS_DISABLE: true
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.593598 sonic ERR syncd#SDK: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_LAG_MEMBER_ATTR_INGRESS_DISABLE: true
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.415477 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- set: switch id oid:0x0 doesn't exist
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.416028 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- setDistributionOnLagMember: Failed to disable distribution on LAG member Ethernet0
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.416092 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiFailure: Encountered failure in set operation, SAI API: SAI_API_LAG, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.929435 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- set: switch id oid:0x0 doesn't exist
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.929478 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- setCollectionOnLagMember: Failed to disable collection on LAG member Ethernet0
2025 Aug  7 <IPV6>.929519 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiFailure: Encountered failure in set operation, SAI API: SAI_API_LAG, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
```

There is a check in CLI but the check just checks config_db https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/1418f218825484551b1f8893ff836d420f0a6135/config/main.py#L2728

### Steps to Reproduce

config vlan add 10
config vlan member add 10 Ethernet0

In a parallel session attach gdb to orchagent.

config vlan member del 10 Ethernet0
config portchannel add PortChannel1
config portchannel member add PortChannel1 Ethernet0

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior: Errors in logs and crash prior to 202505

Expected behavior. No errors in log or crash.

resolution.title: [portsorch]: Fix Errors when removing VLAN member and adding port to P…
resolution.description:
This PR fixed the bug Fixes sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#23635

**Summary**

When a port is removed from a VLAN and added to a PortChannel in quick succession (e.g., when orchagent is busy), the operations queue up in Redis. Because orchagent processes `LAG_MEMBER_TABLE` before `VLAN_MEMBER_TABLE` (alphabetical order at the same priority), it attempts to add the port to the LAG while the port is still a bridge member. This causes SAI error `"Can't add port which is under bridge"` and a crash on versions prior to 202505.

The fix defers the LAG member addition when `m_portVlanMember` for the port is non-empty, allowing the VLAN member removal to complete first. On the next `doTask()` cycle, the LAG member addition proceeds successfully.

**How I verified it**

1. **End-to-end testing on canonical SONiC testbed:**
```
$ sudo config vlan add 12
<IPV6>.434747 NOTICE addVlan: Create an empty VLAN Vlan12 vid:12 vlan_oid:260000000005ae
```

```
$ sudo config vlan member add 12 Ethernet0
<IPV6>.034743 NOTICE addVlanMember: Add member Ethernet0 to VLAN Vlan12 vid:12 pid1000000000017
```
gdb pause orchagent in another session, then in previous session, run:
```
sudo config vlan member del 12 Ethernet0
sudo config portchannel add PortChannel1
sudo config portchannel member add PortChannel1 Ethernet0
```

then continue gdb in the other session, then we will see:

```
2026 Mar 12 <IPV6>.123568 sonic INFO swss#orchagent: :- doLagMemberTask: Port Ethernet0 is still a member of 1 VLAN(s), skipping adding port to port channel.
2026 Mar 12 <IPV6>.123568 sonic INFO swss#orchagent: :- doLagMemberTask: Port Ethernet0 is still a member of 1 VLAN(s), skipping adding port to port channel.
2026 Mar 12 <IPV6>.125843 sonic INFO swss#orchagent: :- doLagMemberTask: Port Ethernet0 is still a member of 1 VLAN(s), skipping adding port to port channel.
 ...
2026 Mar 12 <IPV6>.136631 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeVlanMember: Remove member Ethernet0 from VLAN Vlan12 lid:c vmid:270000000005b0

...
2026 Mar 12 <IPV6>.209554 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addLagMember: Add member Ethernet0 to LAG PortChannel1 lid:20000000005b1 pid:1000000000017
```

and validate the SAI message disappear:
   ```
   show logging | grep "Can't add port which is under bridge"
   # Returns nothing (no SAI error)
   ```
2. **C++ mock test** (`tests/mock_tests/portsorch_ut.cpp`): `VlanLagRaceTest.LagMemberAddDeferredWhileVlanMemberPending` — verifies the LAG member add is deferred while `m_portVlanMember` is non-empty, then succeeds after the VLAN member removal completes across two `doTask()` cycles. Runs automatically during swss `.deb` build.
